sources.title: An 80B-parameter model just ran in 4.3 GB of RAM - privateslm.dev
sources.snippet: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B is an 80-billion-parameter model. Its 4-bit GGUF-equivalent weights take up 42 GB on disk. An independent builder going by leonickson1 got it generating text on an ordinary Apple Silicon Mac using a peak of 4.3 GB of RAM — under a tenth of the file size — by never loading most of the model into memory at all.
